children: Madan brings 22 years of HR experience across automotive, engineering and electronics, with previous leadership roles at WIKA Group and Mahindra & Mahindra

Siddharth Grease & Lubes has appointed Nitesh Madan as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), tasking him with leading the company's people strategy and human resources transformation. Madan brings 22 years of experience across the automotive, engineering and electronics sectors, having held HR leadership positions at WIKA Group, Mahindra & Mahindra, Ericsson and Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India.

In his new role, Madan will focus on organisational capability building, leadership development, talent management and performance management. His responsibilities will also include using technology to strengthen HR processes and aligning people practices with the company's business priorities.

Before joining Siddharth Grease & Lubes, Madan worked as an independent human resources consultant from October 2022 to October 2026. During this period, he advised organisations on talent strategy, HR process improvement, organisational development and scalable people structures.

Earlier, he served as Head of Human Resources – India Group at WIKA Group from April 2019 to October 2022. He oversaw people management across four Indian subsidiaries, with responsibilities spanning HR systems, policies and processes.

His work at WIKA included restructuring three entities into one, digitising HR processes and introducing a performance-based appraisal mechanism. He also participated in a global talent development framework project.

Madan spent over four years at Mahindra & Mahindra in HR business partnering roles. From January 2017 to April 2019, he supported three manufacturing plants within the Swaraj Division, working with functions including production planning, engineering and stores.

His responsibilities included leadership hiring, frontline leadership development and individual development plans for critical talent. He also served as an HR business partner at Mahindra's integrated tractor manufacturing plant in Nagpur, overseeing HR processes for white-collar employees and supporting more than 1,000 trainees across engine and transmission operations.

Before Mahindra, Madan worked for four years at Ericsson India as Manager – HR, where he contributed to implementing an integrated talent management system powered by SAP SuccessFactors at its Jaipur manufacturing unit.
He also spent over seven years at Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India, handling talent planning, recruitment, campus hiring, performance appraisal development and job evaluation.

Madan began his career as Executive – HR at TCI Group in September 2002, managing recruitment, learning and development, payroll and compliance across Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. He holds an MBA in Human Resource Management from Amity University.
